messages:
anya_docs: FYI opened a docs PR that adds a minimal 'route-level cost attribution' dashboard example + compact SDK snippets for python/go. playground preview is failing, looks like the tracehook snippet has the wrong env var name. can someone take a quick look?

jess_m: link?

anya_docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523 — failing preview at `Playground preview (docs)` job. error is a 400 from trace ingest.

miles_infra: quick guess: the snippet uses `TRACE_API_KEY` instead of the runtime's `TRACE_KEY`. seen that mixup before in runtime examples.

samuel: confirmed — that'll lead to 400. also the example sets `REDWOOD_ENV=prod` which breaks the preview routing. use `dev` or omit for the docs preview.

anya_docs: oops, copy-pasted from Dedicated docs. can one of you push a patch so I don't rerun the whole CI?

jess_m: I can open a fix PR. will swap to `TRACE_KEY` and remove `REDWOOD_ENV`. also will normalize the dashboard YAML: it references `cost_usd` but our export currently uses `cost_cents`. i'll rename and add a short note about converting to dollars in the UI. :+1:

devex-bot: Preview deployed — https://playground.redwood.test/pr-4523-preview (expires in 24h)

miles_infra: when you update, could you also add a tiny lint step to CI that renders the tracehook snippet and hits the ingest endpoint with a test header? saves future flakiness.

jess_m: added a smoke job patch in the PR: `docs-smoke:run-snippets` — it'll POST a small test event to the sandbox ingest. keeping it short.

anya_docs: also would love a one-line Python snippet that demonstrates reading trace metadata and extracting `route` for attribution — nothing fancy, just something copy-pastable.

samuel: minimal python example:```python
import os
from redwood import TraceHook

hook = TraceHook(api_key=os.getenv("TRACE_KEY"))
trace = hook.fetch_latest()
route = trace.metadata.get("route")
print(f"route={route}, latency_ms={trace.latency_ms}")
```

anya_docs: perfect — i'll add that into the inline snippet block and a short sentence about using `cost_cents` -> `/100` for display.

jess_m: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4524 — includes env var fix, YAML key rename, added python example, and the smoke job. running CI now.

miles_infra: watching preview. if dashboard rendering mismatches still happen, likely due to the sample dashboard referencing `metric.cost_cents` vs `metric.cost_usd` in the renderer — will ping when I spot it.

anya_docs: thanks team. if merge is blocked by conflicts I can rebase, otherwise please merge once green. will follow up to add a small note in the migration guide for console observability about the cost field rename. :rocket:
